annotations.title: Trading fee schedules per venue, base tier maker and taker

description: Call this when the user asks what an exchange charges to trade, how maker and taker fees compare across venues, whether a venue changed its fees, or what a round trip costs on a given notional. Returns base tier maker and taker per venue and market type (median across pairs where the venue prices per pair) and the fee change log, read daily by ByKaranteli from each venue's own fee endpoint.
name: get_fee_table
